card.name: Inside long split-up words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a longer word split into parts, often after a start like Ant, Ex, Eff or av. Seen in words such as antepartum, antecubital, antebellum, excerpts and effigy, and in drug names such as avanc- and aviren-.

modes.label: Ante- and ex- words
modes.description: A middle piece after ant- or ex- inside a Latin-style word.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece inside a drug brand or generic name.

card.plain: It fires on the middle chunk of a long or unusual word that is spelled out in pieces, such as antepartum or excerpts.
